content.text:
Fixed — sessions and trash are now per-workspace. `SessionStore` (src/sessionStore.ts:45) was persisting to `context.globalState`, which VS Code shares across all workspaces; it now uses `context.workspaceState`. Trash needed no separate change since trashed sessions live in the same store.

One migration note: your three existing sessions were stored globally with no record of which folder they belonged to, so the first workspace you open after reloading the extension adopts them (then the global copy is cleared). If they land in the wrong folder, just trash them there. Type check passes.
